vachanas.kannada:
ಕೊಲಲಾರದೆಯೆ
ಹಿಂದೆ ಬಂದುದನರಿದುದಿಲ್ಲಾಗಿ,
ಮುಂದೆ ಬಾಹದಕೆ ನೀ ಚಿಂತಿಸಲೇಕೆ ?
ಇಂದಿಗೆಂಬುದು ಲಿಂಗದೊಲವು.
ಶಿವಶರಣಂಗೆ ನಾಳೆ ಇಂದು ಎಂಬ ಅಭಾವವಿಲ್ಲ.
ಕಡುಗಲಿಯಾದ ಶರಣ ರಕ್ಷೆಯ ಕಾಯವೇನಯ್ಯಾ,
ಅಖಂಡ ಮಂಡಲೇಶ್ವರಾ.
vachanas.transliteration:
kolalāradeye
hinde bandudanaridudillāgi,
munde bāhadake nī cintisalēke ?
indigembudu liṅgadolavu.
śivaśaraṇaṅge nāḷe indu emba abhāvavilla.
kaḍugaliyāda śaraṇa rakṣeya kāyavēnayyā,
akhaṇḍa maṇḍalēśvarā.
vachanas.translation:
Unable to kill it,
One knows not what has passed before.
Why then do you worry
About what is yet to come?
For the one who abides in the love of the Liṅga,
There is only the present.
For the Śiva-śaraṇa,
There is neither "tomorrow" nor "today."
What concern is there
For the protection of the body
Of the steadfast and valiant śaraṇa,
O Akhaṇḍa Maṇḍaleśvara?

vachanas.kannada:
ಹೇಮ ಕಾಮಿನಿ ಭೂಮಿ ಜೀವರಾಧಾರ,
ಜೀವರ ಪ್ರಾಣ, ಜೀವರ ಸಿಕ್ಕು ತೊಡಲು.
ಇಹಪರದೊಳಗೆ ಜಂಘೆಯ ಬಿಟ್ಟು,
ಲಂಘಿಸಿ ನಿಂದಾತನೆ ವಿರತಿ ಸಮಗ್ರ ಕಾಣಾ,
ಮರ್ಕಟೇಶ್ವರಾ.
vachanas.transliteration:
hēma kāmini bhūmi jīvarādhāra,
jīvara prāṇa, jīvara sikku toḍalu.
ihaparadoḷage jaṅgheya biṭṭu,
laṅghisi nindātane virati samagra kāṇā,
markaṭēśvarā.
vachanas.translation:
Gold, women, and land—
These are the very support of worldly life,
The life-breath of beings,
And the bonds that hold them fast.
He who has cast aside these shackles
Both in this world and the next,
Crossing beyond them altogether—
Know him alone to possess complete renunciation,
O Markaṭeśvara.
